events.title: The Kids’ Tafsir Reading Club
events.description: The Kids' Tafsir Reading Club is open to children ages 7-10, and will meet every other week, on Sundays from 10:30 AM-11:30 AM. Every other Sunday 10:30AM-11:30AM, starting March 2nd
